calibration.method: Swell period fitted per tier against Gold Days on the Copernicus IBI wave reanalysis, split on Big-Wave Season boundaries. The Watch bar is the highest period catching every Gold Day in the fitting split. The Go Call bar is the lowest period sitting above the Watch bar and within 8 Go Calls per Big-Wave Season; in this fit what actually set it was the budget of 8 Go Calls per Big-Wave Season. Height and both arcs were verified to block no Gold Day rather than fitted. The light-wind exemption (ADR 0009) was fitted, not verified: 16.5 km/h, the lowest value admitting the 6 Gold Days in the fitting split that no hour passes on direction and speed alone, the calmest hour of the windiest of them being 16.3 km/h. The wave bars above are in Open-Meteo units, which is what the Pipeline Run reads; the fit ran in reanalysis units, where the same sea reports a longer swell period, and chose 2.75 m / 10.5 s / 13.5 s. Translated by significant_wave_height_m: operational = 0.9412 x reanalysis +0.3435 (fitted on 4366 hours >= 3 m, residual RMSE 0.217); swell_period_s: operational = 0.9307 x reanalysis +0.2924 (fitted on 4366 hours >= 3 m, residual RMSE 0.508) (analysis/overlap/README.md). The light-wind exemption is not translated: wind reaches the fit and the Pipeline Run alike from ERA5, so it is already in the units it is applied in.
